description: Choose GitHub activity or share a contribution in your own words.
help: Choose what to share. GitHub activity is optional, and you can add a contribution without connecting an account.
highlightsHelp: A small improvement, a review, documentation, or helping a community all count. A title, a link, or a short note is enough.

activity.title: GitHub activity (optional)
activity.help: Add an optional calendar, summary, or repository languages. Your public activity does not measure what you know.
activity.usernameHelp: Only the username, with or without @. We query GitHub when you choose to.
activity.queryFirst: Check your username to enable the optional cards. Nothing is selected automatically.
activity.choose: What would you like to include?

calendar.label: Contribution calendar
calendar.help: Contributions over the last year, without streaks or rankings.

summary.label: Activity summary
summary.help: Commits, pull requests, issues, and reviews for the same period.

languages.label: Repository languages
languages.help: Languages by code size in your public, non-fork repositories. This is not a skills assessment.

activity.scope: Cards use the activity GitHub makes available. They can be left out or removed at any time.
activity.empty: No contributions were found for this period. You can still share technologies, projects, or contributions in your own words.
activity.stale: Showing the last available data. It may have changed on GitHub.
activity.privateCounts: The calendar includes anonymous counts of private contributions. Private details are not shown.
activity.languageLimit: Languages cover {analyzed} of {total} repositories because of the query limit.

errors.invalid_username: Enter a valid GitHub username, with or without @, up to 39 characters. Use letters, numbers, or single hyphens between them.
errors.not_found: We could not find that GitHub account. Check the username and try again.
errors.not_configured: GitHub activity is not enabled on this instance yet. You can still add your featured contributions below.
errors.rate_limited: GitHub's request limit was reached. Try again later; you can keep editing your profile.
errors.unavailable: GitHub activity could not be loaded. Try again; you can keep editing your profile.

empty: Add a way you have helped a project, a person, or a community.
title: Contribution title
titleHelp: Name your contribution, or leave this empty and describe it below.
descriptionHelp: Optional. A short note about your contribution is enough.
descriptionPlaceholder: Reviewed setup instructions and helped new learners get started.
urlHelp: Optional. Use a full http:// or https:// address, without spaces or sign-in credentials.
invalidUrl: Enter a valid http:// or https:// address without spaces or sign-in credentials, or leave this field empty.
removeHelp: Removing this entry deletes its title, description, and link from your draft. Hide the section instead to keep them.
